name: Ishbi-Benob
title: Philistine giant from the Rephaim clan
summary: Ishbi-Benob was a Philistine giant of the Rephaim clan (the race of giants) who attempted to kill King David during a battle against the Philistines. He was armed with a new sword and a spear weighing three hundred shekels of bronze. He was killed by Abishai, son of Zeruiah, who came to David's rescue.

keyEvents.title: Battle against David
keyEvents.description: Ishbi-Benob, a descendant of Rapha (the giants), planned to kill David during a war with the Philistines. He was armed with a new sword and a bronze spear weighing three hundred shekels.

keyEvents.title: David became exhausted
keyEvents.description: During the battle, David grew weary, and Ishbi-Benob saw his chance to try to strike him down. This was a critical situation for the king of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Abishai rescues David
keyEvents.description: Abishai, son of Zeruiah, came to David's aid and struck down the Philistine giant Ishbi-Benob. This saved David's life in a very dangerous situation.

keyEvents.title: David's men take an oath
keyEvents.description: After this event, David's men swore that he would no longer go out to battle with them, so that the lamp of Israel would not be extinguished. Thus, Ishbi-Benob's attack led to David withdrawing from direct combat.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Philistine Wars
keyEvents.description: The incident with Ishbi-Benob is part of a collection of accounts about wars against Philistine giants from the Rephaim clan, where several of David's heroes killed giants.
